plugins.name: context-rotation
plugins.description: Measures how full a Claude Code session's context is, warns before it degrades, and carries a checked handover into a fresh session after /clear.

plugins.name: slop-lint
plugins.description: Deterministic linter for AI tics in Dutch prose: em-dashes, buzzwords, comma chains and rhetorical frames. Lints every text file Claude writes and hands the findings back so Claude fixes them.
